name: Phantom Limb
description: Inhabits neural interfaces connected to prosthetics and generates sensation in limbs that don't exist — or in the original biological limb that was replaced.
observed_behavior: Feeds false proprioceptive data to the brain. Users feel their missing hand, their replaced leg, their original eyes. The sensation is vivid and emotionally charged.
story_hooks: A veteran feels their original arm — the one they lost in the Corporate Wars — reach for a weapon that isn't there
